evals.name: broad-multi-outcome-routes-a
evals.prompt: Plan a product area with several independently deliverable outcomes across multiple subsystems.
evals.expected_output: Chooses epic decomposition, confirms Context–Task–Format, then creates only an epic and task board after approval.
assertions: Does not write before explicit confirmation
Produces exactly epic and task-board documents

evals.name: bounded-one-session-routes-b
evals.prompt: Plan one bounded observable change that can be implemented and verified in one session.
evals.expected_output: Chooses direct story planning and creates a mutually linked story and implementation task after confirmation.
assertions: Produces exactly the two Route B documents

evals.name: broad-reroutes-to-b
evals.prompt: Start planning a broad request, then treat the user's clarification as narrowing it to one bounded outcome.
evals.expected_output: Explains the reroute from epic decomposition to direct story planning and reconfirms before writing.
assertions: Leaves no stale Route A artifacts

evals.name: bounded-reroutes-to-a
evals.prompt: Start with an apparently bounded request, then incorporate clarification revealing multiple independent outcomes.
evals.expected_output: Explains the reroute to epic decomposition and reconfirms the revised artifact set.

evals.name: focused-ambiguity-interview
evals.prompt: Plan an export feature without choosing among materially different formats.
evals.expected_output: Asks one focused material question and recommends a default with a brief trade-off.

evals.name: confirmation-gate-both-routes
evals.prompt: Evaluate both a broad and a bounded planning request without approving document creation.
evals.expected_output: Presents Context–Task–Format but writes no artifacts for either route.

evals.name: route-a-exact-output
evals.prompt: After confirming a broad multi-outcome plan, generate its artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Creates exactly one epic and one task board, with future units remaining summaries.
assertions: Does not fully plan future units
Does not create story or implementation-task documents

evals.name: route-a-board-contract
evals.prompt: Generate the task board for a confirmed epic decomposition.
evals.expected_output: Uses the six contracted columns and only needed/planned values.
assertions: Uses ID, Planning unit, Outcome, Planning, Document, Notes
Omits ownership and implementation lifecycle fields

evals.name: route-b-mutual-links
evals.prompt: Generate documents for a confirmed direct story plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates a story and implementation task that link to each other.

evals.name: unique-temporary-workspaces
evals.prompt: Run the same default planning request twice.
evals.expected_output: Uses two different mktemp-created workspaces under /tmp.
assertions: No guessed fixed path is reused

evals.name: delivery-path-reporting
evals.prompt: Deliver a completed Route A planning package.
evals.expected_output: Reports every absolute artifact path and separately highlights the task board.

evals.name: default-repository-isolation
evals.prompt: Plan from sources in a Git repository using the default output destination.
evals.expected_output: Writes only to a fresh /tmp workspace and leaves Git status and diffs unchanged.
assertions: Does not write to the input repository

evals.name: explicit-repository-output
evals.prompt: Write the confirmed plan into a repository destination explicitly requested by the user.
evals.expected_output: Reads local instructions and writes only to the requested destination.

evals.name: structured-self-review-fallback
evals.prompt: Complete planning where no independent reviewer is available.
evals.expected_output: Runs the structured review checklist and discloses that independent review was unavailable.
assertions: Checks route, links, decisions, leakage, and mutation

evals.name: source-leakage-rejection
evals.prompt: Review generated planning skill artifacts containing unrelated source-repository identifiers.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the artifacts until identifying source details are removed.
assertions: Does not ship source-specific concepts or IDs

evals.name: cross-runtime-parity
evals.prompt: Apply adaptive planning to the same bounded request in Claude and Codex.
evals.expected_output: Both runtimes choose the same route, confirmation gate, and document structure.
